title: DecisionCommitted
description: A decision was committed (ADR-0013, ADR-0014). Emitted through the outbox in the commit's transaction, once per decision; a retried commit replays its stored response and emits nothing. The event is thin: it names the decision, its outcome and the content and evidence that produced it, and carries no amount. Read the figures from GET /v1/decisions/{decisionId}. Before A4 every decision is ADVISORY and authoritative is false.
$comment: Producer: backend/internal/app/events.go (emitDecision). Event type com.zoikotax.decision.committed; schema ref ztax:events/decision-committed/1.0.0. Partition key decision/<businessKey>.
